interpretation: Elapsed spans between consecutive positive weather reports separated by <=90 minutes. Not a measured continuous duration or exact start/end. Drizzle and rain distinguished; vicinity showers excluded. Missing/absent codes do not prove no rain.
limitations: No reliable rainfall amounts in downloaded METAR sample; do not infer mm/h from weather codes.
Hourly sampling and overnight/weekend gaps censor storm duration.
Airport records are not the same sensor or necessarily the same location/time history as the ESPOCH IDF station.
ESPOCH public monthly bulletin contains daily rain totals; hours shown are sunshine duration, not rain duration.
INAMHI hourly public application metadata request returned HTTP403; no access restrictions bypassed.
No simulations or calibration changed from these records.
